briefdescription.para: ThemisDB QUIC/HTTP-3 server built on ngtcp2 + Boost.Asio.

detaileddescription.para:
Handles incoming QUIC datagrams, manages connection state via ngtcp2, and dispatches HTTP/3 streams for high-throughput, low-latency workloads. Key responsibilities:
UDP socket setup, multi-threaded I/O via Boost.Asio thread pool.
ngtcp2 connection lifecycle (initial packet, streams, teardown).
Graceful bounded shutdown via timedJoin (5 s per I/O thread).

simplesect.para: thread_join_no_timeout (W3): All t.join() calls in stop() are replaced by timedJoin() to prevent indefinite block if a thread is stuck.
data_race (RAND_bytes): generateServerCid uses the mutex-guarded safeRandBytes helper (pre-3.x OpenSSL DRBG is not per-thread).
